scene: The glowing book reveals an exit balcony overlooking three bustling transit docks.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone balcony. On the far left, a neon night bus waits with an open door. Near left, the player in a teal jacket holds a glowing blue book. In the centre sits an empty bicycle rickshaw. On the far right, an open ferris wheel gondola hangs level with the railing.
shown: a sleek neon night bus with doors open on the far left
a canopy bicycle rickshaw with an idle driver in the centre
an illuminated ferris wheel gondola hanging open on the far right
